description: Compute player skill ratings from match results with OpenSkill, Glicko-2 or Elo. Handles 1v1, teams, free-for-alls and draws. Stateless: pass earlier ratings back in as players to continue.

algorithm.description: openskill (default, Weng-Lin, for teams and free-for-alls), glicko2, elo, or custom (Club Points)

ranks.description: Finishing position per team, lower is better; equal = draw

teams.description: Each team is a list of player ids; singles: one id per team

params.description: Algorithm parameter overrides, e.g. {"k": 24} for Elo

players.description: Ratings from a previous rate_matches call, keyed by player id; unknown players start at the default

name: rate_matches
title: Rate match results
